title: Sweets and Weight
prompt: What happens if you eat too many sweets?
hint: Answer in 1–3 words: say the result (e.g., 'You gain weight').

ja.prompt: もし甘いものを食べ過ぎるとどうなりますか？
ja.hint: 1〜3語で結果を答えてください。例：「You gain weight」。

local.prompt: もし甘いものを食べ過ぎるとどうなりますか？
local.hint: 1〜3語で結果を答えてください。例：「You gain weight」。

local_pron.prompt: Moshi amaimono o tabesugiru to dō narimasu ka?
local_pron.hint: 1–3 go de kekka o kotaete kudasai. Rei: "You gain weight".

zh.prompt: 如果你吃太多甜食會怎麼樣？
zh.hint: 用1到3個單字回答：說明結果，例如「You gain weight」。

en.prompt: What happens if you eat too many sweets?
en.hint: Answer in 1–3 words: say the result (e.g., 'You gain weight').

en_pron.prompt: wʌt hæpənz ɪf juː iːt tuː ˈmɛni swiːts?
en_pron.hint: ˈænsər ɪn wʌn tuː θriː wɜrdz: seɪ ðə rɪˈzʌlt (iːɡˈzæmpəl: 'Juː geɪn weɪt').

title: Advice to Lose Weight
prompt: What should you do to lose weight?
hint: Give a short advice sentence (3–7 words): 'You should exercise regularly.'

ja.prompt: 痩せるには何をすべきですか？
ja.hint: 3〜7語の短い助言文で答えてください：「You should exercise regularly。」

local.prompt: 痩せるには何をすべきですか？
local.hint: 3〜7語の短い助言文で答えてください：「You should exercise regularly。」

local_pron.prompt: Yaseru ni wa nani o subeki desu ka?
local_pron.hint: 3–7 go no mijikai jogenbun de kotaete kudasai: "You should exercise regularly."

zh.hint: 用3到7個單詞的短句給出建議：「You should exercise regularly。」

en.prompt: What should you do to lose weight?
en.hint: Give a short advice sentence (3–7 words): 'You should exercise regularly.'

en_pron.prompt: wʌt ʃʊd juː duː tuː luːz weɪt?
en_pron.hint: ɡɪv ə ʃɔrt ədˈvaɪs ˈsɛntəns (θriː tuː sɛvən wɜrdz): 'Juː ʃʊd ˈɛksəsaɪz ˈrɛɡjələrli.'

title: Past Regret About Exercise
prompt: According to the sample, when would the speaker have been healthier?
hint: Begin with 'If I had...' and include 'last year' in your answer.
sample: If I had exercised more last year.

ja.prompt: サンプルによれば、いつ話者はもっと健康だったでしょうか？
ja.hint: 「If I had...」で始めて、必ず「last year」を含めてください。
ja.sample: If I had exercised more last year.

local.prompt: サンプルによれば、いつ話者はもっと健康だったでしょうか？
local.hint: 「If I had...」で始めて、必ず「last year」を含めてください。
local.sample: If I had exercised more last year.

local_pron.prompt: Sanpuru ni yoreba, itsu hanashasha wa motto kenkō datta deshō ka?
local_pron.hint: "If I had..." de hajimete, kanarazu "last year" o fukume te kudasai.
local_pron.sample: If I had exercised more last year.

zh.prompt: 根據範例，說話者何時會更健康？
zh.hint: 以 'If I had...' 開頭，並且包含 'last year'。
zh.sample: If I had exercised more last year.

en.prompt: According to the sample, when would the speaker have been healthier?
en.hint: Begin with 'If I had...' and include 'last year' in your answer.
en.sample: If I had exercised more last year.

en_pron.prompt: əˈkɔrdɪŋ tuː ðə ˈsæmpəl, wɛn wʊd ðə ˈspikər hæv bɪn ˈhɛlθiər?
en_pron.hint: bɪˈɡɪn wɪð 'If I had...' ænd ɪnˈklud 'last year' ɪn jɔr ˈænsər.
en_pron.sample: If I had exercised more last year.
